vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: gws-tasks
Version: 1.0.7

The skill is a standard wrapper for managing Google Tasks via the 'gws' CLI tool. It provides documentation for task and task list operations (CRUD) and correctly references a shared authentication mechanism in SKILL.md. No malicious indicators, data exfiltration, or suspicious execution patterns were found.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper around a local 'gws' CLI for Google Tasks and its declared requirements align with that purpose; nothing here requests unrelated credentials or installs arbitrary code, but the skill defers auth and global flags to a sibling SKILL.md that should be reviewed before use.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Google Tasks management) match the runtime instructions: all commands are invocations of the 'gws' CLI's tasks subcommands. Requiring the 'gws' binary is proportional and expected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run gws tasks commands and to consult ../gws-shared/SKILL.md for auth, global flags, and security rules. The instructions themselves do not request unrelated files or env vars, but they explicitly defer authentication details to an external sibling file that must be inspected to understand any credential use or extra behaviors.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This minimizes risk because nothing is downloaded or written by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no env vars and no credentials, which is appropriate for a thin CLI wrapper. However, auth is delegated to ../gws-shared/SKILL.md; that file may require credentials (OAuth tokens, service account keys, etc.), so you should inspect it to confirm any requested secrets are proportional to managing Google Tasks.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request to modify other skills or system-wide settings. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but is not a concern here by itself.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a thin wrapper around a local 'gws' CLI for Google Tasks and appears coherent with that purpose. Before installing, verify: (1) the 'gws' binary that will be used is the legitimate, trusted CLI you expect; (2) inspect the referenced ../gws-shared/SKILL.md to see how authentication is handled and what credentials (if any) it requires; (3) confirm any OAuth/service-account scope requested is limited to Google Tasks and related Workspace surfaces; and (4) only install if you trust the skill owner and the source of the 'gws' binary. If you cannot inspect gws-shared or the gws binary is unknown, proceed cautiously or decline installation.
